# Thinking Orbs — geometry subset

Source: https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/tree/22e74a6467c5fac6394c7f8322c7afe33b5257e1/packages/thinking-orbs
Copyright (c) 2026 Jakub Antalik. MIT; see LICENSE.

Vendored unchanged: engine/core.ts, ribbon.ts, lattice.ts, profiles.ts, types.ts.
Only the dependency-free geometry/painter is used; no React runtime or external requests.
RailTime's lifecycle adapter remains in resources/js/assistant-particle-cloud.js.
The composing, searching and listening preset numbers come from upstream src/presets.ts
at the same revision. The compact header uses its separately tuned 32px preset;
the launcher uses the 64px preset scaled to its existing responsive slot.

Reference: https://www.instagram.com/reels/DdSEfaAxpqq/
Upstream demo: https://libraries.dev/orbs
